title: Summoning Glow — RGB Dragon Display
descriptionHtml:
Your shelf after one switch.

Summoning Glow pairs a painted coiled green dragon with seven translucent star-marked spheres and a remote-controlled RGB base. Display the sculpted detail in daylight, then switch the lighting color to turn the complete scene into the focal point of a desk, shelf, or display case.

Why it earns the space

  • All seven: seven separate translucent orange spheres carry the one-through-seven red-star progression.
  • Color on command: the wired concentric-ring RGB base includes a remote for changing colors and lighting modes.
  • Collector detail: painted scales, a cream underbelly, translucent spheres, and clear structural supports reward a closer look.

What is included

  • Painted PVC coiled dragon figure with yellow burst-shaped internal stand
  • Wired circular RGB LED display base with white rim and clear top
  • Remote control for light colors and modes
  • Seven separate translucent orange spheres with one through seven red stars
  • Three clear structural supports

Assembly: This display arrives in multiple components and requires assembly. Use the component image as a placement reference.

Collector note: The approximately 15–16 cm measurement refers to the dragon figure rather than the full base footprint. Measurements are approximate. Small differences in paint, color, and finish may occur. Intended for display; contains small components and should be kept away from young children.

Collector-item return policy

Change-of-mind returns are not accepted. If your order is lost in transit, arrives damaged or defective, contains the wrong item, or is materially different from its description, contact us within 7 days of delivery—or as soon as the expected delivery window has passed for a lost order—with your order number and any available photos. We will provide a replacement at no additional cost or a refund when a replacement is unavailable or as required by applicable law. View the full policy.
